```{r}
test_ddg <- fread("/Users/xl7/Documents/0.Projects/01.protein-seq-evo-v1/data/decay_pdb/SRC/AF-P12931-F1-model_v4.csv")
test_esm <- fread("/Users/xl7/Documents/0.Projects/00.large_supplements/ESM1v_proteome_wide/all_ESM1v/P12931.csv")
colnames(test_esm)[2] <- "ESM1v"
  
test_ddg[, new_position := pos + 1]
test_ddg[, id := paste0(wtAA, new_position, mutAA)]
test_ddg <- test_ddg %>% dplyr::rename(ddG_pred = `ddG (kcal/mol)`)
  
test_df <- merge(test_ddg, test_esm, by.x = "id", by.y = "variant")
test_df
```

```{r}
test_merged_df <- merge(df_ddg, test_df, by = "id")
nrow(test_merged_df) 
test_merged_df
```


```{r}
allo <- c(313, 314, 320 ,333, 376, 380 ,385, 386, 421, 433 ,436 ,444 ,449, 453 ,462, 465, 466,471, 474, 509 ,533,
          328 ,339, 340 ,348, 387 ,388, 406 ,408, 409 ,410 ,411, 412 ,419, 427 ,429 ,430 ,431 ,432 ,447, 450 ,457)

ortho <- c(277, 279, 281, 282, 284, 296, 298, 389, 391, 394, 396, 407, 428)


fil_test_merged_df <- test_merged_df %>%
  filter(!position.x %in% ortho)

# Fit a loess model using the filtered data
loess_fit_comp <- loess(ESM1v ~ ddG_pred, data = fil_test_merged_df, span = 0.7, family = "symmetric")

# Predict fitted values for ALL data points using the loess model trained on fil_gck_df
test_merged_df$fitted_comp <- predict(loess_fit_comp, newdata = test_merged_df)

# Calculate residuals for ALL points
test_merged_df$residuals_comp <- test_merged_df$ESM1v - test_merged_df$fitted_comp
sum(is.na(test_merged_df$residuals_comp)) #0
test_merged_df
```
```{r}
core_pos <- unique (df_ddg %>% filter (FL_folding_mean_kcal.mol >= 1) %>% pull(position.x))
core_pos
```
```{r}
test_merged_df
test_residue <- test_merged_df %>%
  group_by(position.x) %>%
  summarise(resid_median_esm1v = median(residuals_comp, na.rm = TRUE),
            # resid_median_esm2  = median(resid_esm2,  na.rm = TRUE),
            ddgb_median        = median(FL_activity_mean_kcal.mol,  na.rm = TRUE),
            esm1v_median       = median(ESM1v,       na.rm = TRUE),
            # esm2_median        = median(esm2,        na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(site_type = case_when(position.x %in% ortho ~ "Binding site",
                               position.x %in% allo ~ "Allosteric site",
                               position.x %in% core_pos ~ "Core site",
                               TRUE                        ~ "Non-orthosteric site"))
```
```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
site_cols <- c(
"Non-orthosteric site" = "darkgreen",
"Allosteric site"      = "cyan",
"Active site"         = "orange",
"Core site" = "red"
)
nrow(test_residue)
cor.test(test_residue$esm1v_median, test_residue$ddgb_median, method="spearman") #-0.31
cor.test(test_residue$resid_median_esm1v, test_residue$ddgb_median, method="spearman") #-0.21

p6 <- ggplot(test_residue, aes(x = ddgb_median , y = esm1v_median, color = site_type)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(
    title = "SRC",
    subtitle = "Spearman's rho = -0.68",
    x = "Experimental median ddGb",
    y = "Median ESM1v",
    color = "") +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Non-orthosteric site" = "darkgreen",
    "Allosteric site" = "cyan",
    "Binding site" = "orange",
    "Core site" = "red"
  )) + theme(legend.position = "none") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5, color = "grey") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5, color = "grey") 


p8 <- ggplot(test_residue, aes(x = ddgb_median , y = resid_median_esm1v, color = site_type)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(
    title = "SRC",
    subtitle = "Spearman's rho = -0.62",
    x = "Experimental median ddGb",
    y = "Median ESM1v-ddGf residual",
    color = "") +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Non-orthosteric site" = "darkgreen",
    "Allosteric site" = "cyan",
    "Binding site" = "orange",
    "Core site" = "red"
  )) + theme(legend.position = "none") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5, color = "grey") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5, color = "grey") 

plot_grid(p6,p8,ncol=2)
```
